scan_configuration:
[extend]
useDefault = true

[[allowlists]]
description = "SHA256 world identifiers in retained synthetic experiment manifests"
condition = "AND"
paths = ['''^reports/preflight/(synthetic-campaign-smoke-v2|synthetic-campaign-smoke|synthetic-large-smoke|uncertainty-main-manifest|integer-campaign-audit-progress)\.json$''']
regexTarget = "line"
regexes = ['''^\s*"key": "[0-9a-f]{64}",?\s*$''']

[[allowlists]]
description = "Public archive filenames in the unmodified Zenodo deposit metadata"
condition = "AND"
paths = ['''^data/rights/zenodo-record-full-20261015\.json$''']
regexTarget = "match"
regexes = ['''key": "KuaiRand-(1K|27K|Pure)\.tar\.gz"''']

[[allowlists]]
description = "SHA256 intervention world identifiers, recomputed from the public synthetic spec"
condition = "AND"
paths = ['''^reports/preflight/intervention-multidimensional-smoke\.json$''']
regexTarget = "line"
regexes = ['''^\s*"world_key": "[0-9a-f]{64}",?\s*$''']

[[allowlists]]
description = "Public synthetic world hashes, all independently recomputed in public-world-digest-scan-validation.json"
condition = "AND"
paths = ['''^reports/preflight/(synthetic-main-original-manifest|synthetic-main-reconciled-manifest|integer-campaign-audit-manifest|synthetic-recovery-interpretation)\.json$''']
regexTarget = "line"
regexes = ['''^\s*"key": "[0-9a-f]{64}",?\s*$''']

[[allowlists]]
description = "Exact public synthetic recovery identifier verified in reconciled campaign"
condition = "AND"
paths = ['''^reports/preflight/synthetic-recovery-audit-reconciliation\.json$''']
regexTarget = "line"
regexes = ['''^\s*"key": "c9c92bde175d0591e04135bfdc5047e03db404dedaeaae1a60ee4b6ad398f2d8",?\s*$''']
scope: Exact candidate extracted and scanned without generated scanner controls in input. One exact verified synthetic identifier exception. Restricted data-file policy checked; not semantic privacy proof or ship-ready verdict.
